source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3 with Figs. 9.10 to 9.13 (PDF 198-200).

blocks.text: Jab kisi electric field mein raqbe ka ek hissa (element of area) rakhein to kuch lines of force us se guzarti hain (Fig. 9.10). Raqbe ke kisi hisse se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad us raqbe se electric flux kehlati hai, aur aam taur par Yunani harf phi_e se zahir ki jati hai. Maslan Fig. 9.10 mein raqbe A se electric flux 4 hai jabke B se 2. Flux ko miqdari maani dene ke liye field lines is tarah khinchi jati hain ke kisi nuqte par lines ke amudi rakhe unit raqbe se guzarne wali lines ki tadaad us nuqte par field ki intensity E ho.

blocks.alt: Magenta field lines oopar jati aur phailti hain. Neeche jahan qareeb hain, chhota peela raqba A 4 lines se guzarta hai. Oopar jahan door hain, barabar peela raqba B 2 lines se.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.10: E ke amudi sath se electric flux (kitab ki Figure 9.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flux yani raqbe se guzarne wali lines ki tadaad: A se 4 aur B se 2. Barabar raqba hote hue A par lines ghani hain, is liye wahan field zyada taqatwar hai.
Aam taur par raqbe ke hisse ko vector area A se zahir karte hain, jis ki miqdar us hisse ke sath ke raqbe A ke barabar aur simt raqbe ke amud (normal) ke saath hai.

items: Raqba A field lines ke amudi (Fig. 9.11a): us se EA lines guzarti hain, to phi_e = EA (print mein 9.7 number); flux zyada se zyada hai.
Raqba A field lines ke mutawazi (Fig. 9.11b): koi line raqbe ko nahi kaatti, to phi_e = 0 (print mein 9.8 number); flux kam se kam hai.
Raqba jhuka hua ke us ka vector A, E se zawiya theta banaye (Fig. 9.11c): raqbe ka field lines ke amudi saya (projection) A cos theta lete hain, to phi_e = EA cos theta (9.9).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab flux ki in equations ko numbers (9.7), (9.8) aur (9.9) deti hai, magar yeh teeno numbers is chapter mein pehle hi medium mein force, E = F/q aur F = qE ko mil chuke hain. In equations ke naye numbers hone chahiye; equations khud durust hain.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse, magenta field teer E daen taraf. (a) Maximum: hara raqba field ke aar paar khara, vector A daen taraf E ke saath. (b) Minimum: raqba field ke mutawazi leta hua, A seedha oopar. (c) Raqba jhuka hua, A aur E ke darmiyan zaviya theta; saath peeli dashed patti A cos theta, yani E ke amudi us ka saya (projection).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.11: (a) zyada se zyada; (b) kam se kam; (c) (kitab ki Figure 9.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein saari lines raqbe se guzarti hain: phi = EA (zyada se zyada). (b) mein koi line nahi guzarti: phi = 0. (c) mein sirf E ke amudi saya A cos theta kaam karta hai: phi = EA cos theta = E.A.

blocks.title: Electric flux
blocks.text: Hamwar sath ke tukre se E aur A ke zariye electric flux phi_e = EA cos theta = E.A ... (9.10) hai, jahan theta field lines aur raqbe ke amud ke darmiyan zawiya hai. Electric flux scalar product hone ki wajah se scalar miqdar hai; is ki SI unit N m^2 C^-1 hai.
Charge ko gherne wali sath se electric flux

Ab radius r ke kurre (sphere) ki shakal ki band sath se us ke markaz par rakhe nuqtai charge q ki wajah se electric flux nikalte hain (Fig. 9.12). phi_e = E.A lagane ke liye sath hamwar honi chahiye, is liye kurre ka kul raqba n chhote tukron mein taqseem karte hain jin ke raqbe delta A1, delta A2, ..., delta An hain, aur har vector area ki simt tukre ke bahar ki taraf amud ke saath hai. Tukron ke markazon par electric intensities E1, E2, ..., En hain. Eq. 9.10 ke mutabiq band sath se kul flux phi_e = E1.delta A1 + E2.delta A2 + ... + En.delta An ... (9.11) hai.

blocks.alt: Bara saya-daar kurra, markaz par +q. Sath ke chhote tukre Delta A par siyah teer Delta A aur surkh teer E dono seedhe bahar.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.12: markaz par charge q ki wajah se kurre ki sath se kul flux q/ε0 hai (kitab ki Figure 9.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har tukre par E aur Delta A ek hi simt (bahar) mein hain, is liye theta = 0 aur flux E Delta A hai. Saare tukre jod kar E x 4 pi r^2 = q/ε0 milta hai.

Har tukre par electric intensity aur vector area ki simt ek hai, aur |E1| = |E2| = ... = |En| = E = (1/(4 pi eps0)) q/r^2 ... (9.12). Chunke E vector area ke mutawazi hai, theta = 0 aur E.delta A = E delta A cos 0 = E delta A. To phi_e = E (delta A1 + delta A2 + ... + delta An) = E x (kurre ka kul raqba) = (1/(4 pi eps0)) (q/r^2) x 4 pi r^2, jis se phi_e = q/eps0 ... (9.13).

Ab ek band sath S ka tasawwur karein jo is kurre ko ghere (Fig. 9.13): S se flux wahi hai jo kurre se. Yun band sath se kul flux band sath ki shakal ya geometry par munhasir nahi; yeh medium aur andar band charge par munhasir hai.

blocks.alt: Be-qaida gulabi band sath S ek halke hare kurre ko gherti hai jis ke markaz par +q hai. Seedhi magenta lines +q se kurre aur S dono ke paar bahar jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.13 (kitab ki Figure 9.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jo line kurre se nikalti hai wohi S se bhi nikalti hai, is liye S se flux bhi q/ε0 hai. Flux sath ki shakal par nahi, andar band charge par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt: 10 cm^2 raqbe ki disc amudi field E = 5 x 10^5 N C^-1 mein rakhi hai aur us ki satah ufuq se 30 degrees par hai; us se flux nikalein (numerical 9.6).
blocks.explanation: Disc ka amud amudi field se 30 degrees banata hai, to phi = EA cos 30 = 5 x 10^5 x 10 x 10^-4 x 0.866 = 433 N m^2 C^-1 = 250 sqrt 3 N m^2 C^-1.

items: Flux: raqbe se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad; A amud ke saath vector hai. Amudi: phi = EA; mutawazi: phi = 0; jhuka: phi = EA cos theta = E.A (9.10); scalar, N m^2 C^-1.
Kurre ke markaz par charge q: phi = E x 4 pi r^2 = q/eps0 (9.13), charge ko gherne wali kisi bhi band sath ke liye wahi; medium aur andar band charge par munhasir.
